seo.title: How to Use TranscriptX | AI Transcription Guide
seo.meta_description: Learn how to use TranscriptX to transcribe video and audio with AI. Upload your media, generate accurate transcripts, create subtitles and captions, summarize content, and export results in just a few simple steps.

hero.title: Turn Video and Audio into Text in Minutes
hero.description: TranscriptX makes AI transcription simple. Upload your media, generate accurate transcripts, create subtitles, and summarize content without installing any software.

content: TranscriptX is an AI-powered transcription platform designed to help you convert video and audio into accurate, editable text quickly and easily.

Whether you're transcribing meetings, interviews, podcasts, lectures, webinars, or social media videos, TranscriptX provides everything you need to generate transcripts, subtitles, captions, and AI summaries in one place.
Getting started only takes a few minutes, and everything works directly from your web browser.

2.title: Step 1: Upload Your Video or Audio
body: Start by uploading your audio or video file or using one of TranscriptX's supported online transcription tools.
Whether you're working with a local recording or supported content from platforms such as YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook, TranscriptX prepares your media for AI transcription automatically.
Once your media is uploaded, the transcription process begins within seconds.

3.title: Step 2: Generate an AI Transcript
body: TranscriptX uses advanced AI speech recognition to convert spoken content into accurate, searchable text.
The platform automatically identifies spoken words and generates a structured transcript that is easy to read and edit.
Processing time depends on the length and quality of your recording, but most transcripts are generated quickly.

4.title: Step 3: Review and Edit the Transcript
body: After the transcript is generated, review the content to ensure it matches your expectations.
You can edit names, punctuation, formatting, or any words that require adjustment before using the transcript elsewhere.
This review step helps you achieve the highest possible accuracy for professional, academic, or business use.

5.title: Step 4: Create Subtitles, Captions, or AI Summaries
body: TranscriptX goes beyond basic transcription.
You can generate subtitles and captions for videos, create concise AI summaries of long recordings, and prepare spoken content for publishing, accessibility, research, or content repurposing.
These tools help you save time while making your content easier to understand and share.

6.title: Step 5: Copy, Download, or Reuse Your Content
body: Once you're satisfied with the results, you can copy your transcript, download it, or continue working with it using TranscriptX's AI tools.
Transcripts can be used for documentation, meeting notes, blog articles, subtitles, social media content, research, training materials, and many other workflows.
Your transcript becomes searchable, editable, and much easier to reuse than the original recording.

7.title: More Than AI Transcription
body: TranscriptX combines multiple AI-powered tools into one platform.

In addition to AI Transcription, you can use Video to Text, Audio to Text, YouTube Transcript, TikTok Transcript, Instagram Transcript, Facebook Transcript, Subtitle & Caption tools, and AI Summarization without switching between different services.
This unified workflow helps creators, students, professionals, researchers, and businesses work more efficiently with spoken content.

8.title: Works Anywhere, Anytime
body: TranscriptX works entirely online and requires no software installation.
Simply open the platform in your browser, upload your media, and let AI handle the transcription process.
Whether you're using Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, or iOS, TranscriptX is available whenever you need fast and reliable AI transcription.
